acme_infra: hey team — our streaming responses are aborting mid-token and the client reconnects repeatedly. started after we upgraded python SDK to 0.12.4. seeing lots of partial outputs and duplicate billing events. example log: `heartbeat_mismatch -> closing connection`
Mina S.: sorry to hear that — can you paste the full log lines and sdk version? also are you on K8s nodes or VMs?
acme_infra: sdk=0.12.4, GKE nodes (cos-node image). log snippet: `2026-03-10T14:02:17Z stream(event_id=xx) INFO heartbeat_received ts=167 etc; 2026-03-10T14:02:23Z stream ERROR heartbeat_mismatch ttl=8 client_ts=167 server_ts=175 closing`
Alex R.: hmm heartbeat_mismatch suggests client thought the server heartbeat was stale. Mina can you repro locally? acme, can you check node clock (`date`/`ntpstat`)?
acme_infra: ran `ntpstat` on a node — shows unsynced. `ntpq -p` shows jitter and one stray offset ~+6s. weirdly only affects half the pool.
Priya M.: clock skew could definitely trigger the client to treat valid heartbeats as expired. The SDK change in 0.12.4 tightened allowed skew from 10s -> 2s to avoid hanging connections. if nodes drift >2s you'll see these disconnects.
Mina S.: thanks — that matches timing. Two immediate mitigations: (1) pin clients to 0.12.3 (revert) while we patch, or (2) NTP fix on nodes. Which would you prefer?
acme_infra: need minimal downtime — we'll try node ntp fix first but would like a safe SDK rollback if you recommend. Is there a quick rollback pip command?
Alex R.: `pip install redwood-sdk==0.12.3` will pin. We're preparing a micro-patch to relax the tolerance to 5s and add a runtime config `REDWOOD_SSE_HEARTBEAT_TOLERANCE`. patch PR: https://git.redwood.example/p/1234 — will cut a 0.12.5 patch after review.
Mina S.: adding repro steps for internal ticket: 1) use python SDK 0.12.4 2) artificially advance system clock on client by +5s 3) open streaming SSE chat/iterator and send long completion 4) observe partial tokens then `heartbeat_mismatch` in logs
Alex R.: sharing the core of the fix (inlined):
```
# before (0.12.4)
HEARTBEAT_TOLERANCE_SEC = 2

# after (0.12.5)
HEARTBEAT_TOLERANCE_SEC = int(os.getenv("REDWOOD_SSE_HEARTBEAT_TOLERANCE", "5"))

# client will also log a single warning instead of immediate close if within tolerance
```
Priya M.: will coordinate with infra/customer to patch NTP and verify. Mina can you set up a canary with 0.12.5 once it lands and run a repro harness?
deploy-bot: cherry-pick pr/1234 -> release/0.12.x queued; canary deploy to staging scheduled at 2026-03-11T02:00Z :rocket:
acme_infra: thanks all — we've rolled NTP fix on 2/3 nodes; will keep monitoring. would like confirmation that the server-side won't double-bill partial outputs when clients reconnect in this scenario.
Mina S.: good question — logging note: reconnects may surface as multiple start events but billing is tied to completed tokens; engineering will audit any double-charges. Alex, can you confirm?
Alex R.: billing model: tokens are recorded on the service side when we emit final chunks; partial reconnects can increment in logs but we dedupe by request_id on completion. i'll audit the window for this specific bug and follow up in the ticket.
Priya M.: follow-up checklist: - confirm 0.12.5 increases tolerance + env override - run canary with artificial clock skew - verify no duplicate completed requests in billing pipeline - doc update for SDK upgrade notes
Mina S.: created support ticket S-9931 and linked PR/1234. acme, i'll keep this thread open until you confirm stability. :thumbsup:
acme_infra: 👍 thanks, will update after 24h of traffic.
